description: Pondok Pesantren Hikmatus Sholihiyah Sidoarjo is a prestigious institution offering an educational experience that blends traditional Islamic values with modern international standards. As a leading school from the middle school to high school level, we are dedicated to fostering a learning environment that nurtures academic excellence alongside character development. Teamwork is highly valued, as collaboration with fellow educators is crucial for the success of our educational approach. Excellent communication skills are also required, enabling effective interaction with students, parents, and colleagues. We welcome individuals who are passionate about education, committed to continuous learning, and eager to contribute to our dynamic and inclusive school community. If you share our vision of creating a world-class educational institution, we encourage you to apply.

High Standards: Dream big and deliver epic outcomes fastWhere we workSince Glints was officially launched in Singapore in 2015, we've rapidly grown our footprint across Greater Southeast Asia to operate in Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Philippines.Learn more about Glints and our culture at bit.ly/glintsculture.

description: Requarement: Min. 3 years of experience in Cloud Security Engineering  Experience in Tencent Cloud Security Solid understanding, proficient in architecting and securing multi-account AWS environments and GCP projectsSolid understanding in IAM policy concepts, least privileges access, MFA, VPC Service Controls, GuardrailsDetermined, has the confident in taking ownership of cloud infrastructure security tasksHands on with Infrastructure-as-Code, preferably TerraformAbility to design security observability dashboards and metrics1. Organization policyPrinciple of Least Privilege: Users and systems should only have the minimum permissions needed to perform their jobs.Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Mandatory for all accounts, particularly administrative ones, to prevent unauthorized access from compromised credentials.Continuous Verification: A "Zero Trust" approach where every access attempt is verified regardless of its origin. 2. Access managementEncryption at Rest and in Transit: Sensitive data must be encrypted while stored (e.g., in databases) and while moving between systems (e.g., using TLS 1.3).Key Management: Securely store and rotate encryption keys, often using dedicated Key Management Services (KMS) or hardware security modules (HSM).Data Residency: Ensuring data is stored and processed in specific geographic regions to meet sovereignty requirements. 3. Tencent Cloud Security best practiceVirtual Private Clouds (VPC): Logically isolated sections of the cloud to control network traffic.Micro-segmentation: Dividing the network into smaller segments to limit "lateral movement" if a breach occurs.Web Application Firewalls (WAF): Protecting cloud applications from common web exploits.  4. Compliance and GovernanceRegulatory Alignment: Adherence to standards like GDPR (privacy), HIPAA (healthcare), and PCI DSS (payments).Security Frameworks: Using benchmarks such as ISO/IEC 27017 (cloud-specific security) or the NIST Cybersecurity Framework to guide policies.Regular Audits: Scheduled reviews of configurations and logs to detect "drift" from security baselines. 5. Threat detection & Risk AwarenessContinuous Monitoring: Real-time tracking of logs (e.g., using a SIEM system) to detect unusual activity like unauthorized API calls or mass downloads.Incident Response Playbook: A predefined plan for identifying, containing, and recovering from security breaches.Backup and Recovery: Regular, encrypted backups with a tested Disaster Recovery strategy to ensure business continuity

description: At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential.Join Glints as a Software Engineer Intern and be part of our mission to help people and organizations realize their human potential. You’ll work with experienced engineers on real-world products that power job matching, hiring, and talent development in Southeast Asia.Whether your focus is frontend, backend, or full-stack, you’ll build scalable solutions, learn agile development, and gain mentorship from Glints’ high-performance engineering team.A Pathway to Your Full-Time CareerPlease note: This program is designed as a direct launchpad for a full-time career at Glints. Our primary goal is to mentor and develop promising talent into long-term team members.Full-Time Conversion: While not guaranteed, this internship has a strong potential for a full-time (FT) offer. Conversion is based on your performance during the program and business needs at the time of completion.Eligibility: Because of this, the ideal candidate is a final-year university student or a recent graduate who is able to transition into a full-time role.Commitment & Location: This is a full-time role. While the on-site requirement for the internship is negotiable, we expect you to work from our office upon conversion to a full-time position.What You'll Be DoingIn this role, you will:- Collaborate with an agile development team to support the delivery of impactful web features and improvements.- Assist in building and testing web application features, primarily using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and React or similar frameworks.- Support frontend development tasks such as fixing bugs, improving UI, or implementing small features under close guidance.- Participate in code reviews, and team discussions where you will learn industry best practices and coding standards.- Be mentored by team members and gradually take on more responsibility as you grow in technical confidence and capability.Why You Should Join Us- Collaboration: You’ll be part of a supportive and diverse team, learning from experienced engineers while contributing to real projects in a collaborative environment.- Real-World Experience: You will be working on one of our biggest products by user base, which is currently one of the leading job marketplaces in Indonesia.- Multicultural Environment: Join a multicultural team with members from different countries. We value your unique background and fresh perspective.- Learning & Innovation: We encourage curiosity and creativity. You’ll be supported to explore new ideas and grow your technical and problem-solving skills.- Meaningful Contribution: Your work will help improve a platform that positively impacts the careers of millions of young professionals across Southeast Asia.Who We Are Looking For We’re looking for enthusiastic learners who are passionate about web development and eager to grow through hands-on experience. While we don’t expect interns to be experts, we value a strong foundation, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.- Web Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.- Frontend Development: Some experience in React and frameworks like Next.js, and a desire to learn how modern web applications are built.- APIs: Basic understanding of how web apps communicate with backend services using REST or GraphQL.- Version Control: Familiarity with Git for tracking code changes and collaborating with a team.- Responsive Design: Awareness of responsive design principles and the ability to create layouts that work across devices.- Performance Awareness: Interest in learning how to make websites fast and efficient.- Security Awareness: Open to learning best practices for keeping web applications secure.Soft Skills- Problem-Solving: A logical mindset and curiosity to debug and figure things out.- Communication: Ability to ask good questions, explain what you're working on, and share progress or blockers clearly.- Team Collaboration: Willingness to work closely with peers and mentors, and to contribute to a supportive team environment.- Adaptability: Comfortable learning new tools, frameworks, and adapting to feedback.- Attention to Detail: Care in writing clean, working code and testing what you build.- Continuous Learning: Enthusiasm for improving your skills and keeping up with web development trends.- Agile Mindset: Willingness to work in an iterative process, take part in standups, and deliver work in small, valuable chunks.Let's Realize Human Potential.At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential.We have impacted many lives but there’s still plenty to be done. If you’re ready to grow and make an impact, you’ve come to the right place.What is Glints?Glints is the leading talent ecosystem in Southeast Asia, with an enduring purpose of contributing to a world where people and organizations can realize their human potential. Today, Glints is the most well-funded and well-capitalized startup in the talent recruitment space in Southeast Asia, with over US$80M in total investments raised till date.Our tech-enabled approach to recruitment and career discovery connects more than 3 million candidates to their next dream opportunities. We have also supported more than 50,000 companies in finding top talent and doubling recruitment efficiency.Our agility and firm hold on our core purpose and values have allowed us to remain resilient and thrive through tumultuous times. In 2020, we were recognized by LinkedIn as one of the Top 10 Startups in Singapore. In 2022, we were featured in the top 20 of Nikkei-FT-Statista High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2021 list. Moreover, we were also featured in the top 10 fastest-growing companies in Singapore by The Straits Times.Who We AreAt Glints, personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth. That's why we created the Glints Culture Code: #RIIBCOH. It defines our values, is what guides our decisions and actions, and is what makes us special.#RIIBCOH:1. Relentlessly Resourceful: Whatever it takes, just make it happen (ethically)2. Integrity: Have courage, be guided by the truth, don’t be afraid 3. Impact: Missionaries, not mercenaries4. Beginners’ Mindset: Stay humble, don’t be attached to ego5. Customer Obsessed: Customers First6. Ownership: Care intensely about the mission and take responsibility7. High Standards: Dream big and deliver epic outcomes fastWhere we workSince Glints was officially launched in Singapore in 2015, we've rapidly grown our footprint across Greater Southeast Asia to operate in Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Philippines.

description:
Deskripsi Perusahaan PT  Waschen Alora Indonesia (Alora Group) adalah sebuah entitas induk perusahan yang memiliki core business di bidang jasa kebersihan, seperti: Laundry rumah sakit (Healtcare Laundry), Penyewaan linen rumah sakit (Linen Rental), Laundry untuk Perusahaan (Corporate Laundry), Laundry Retail (residence), Jasa kebersihan rumah (Home Care) dan Jasa Kebersihan Kantor (Office Care). Kami mengundang talenta terbaik yang memiliki dedikasi, berpikiran terbuka (growth mindset) dan loyalitas untuk pengembangan karir dan pengembangan bisnis demi kemajuan bersama di masa depan. Kami tidak mencari sekadar analis data. Kami mencari “arsitek pertumbuhan”, seseorang yang mampu mengubah data menjadi strategi, dan strategi menjadi dampak nyata.  Kami mencari “problem solver berbasis data”, seseorang yang mampu melihat pola di balik angka, memahami bisnis secara mendalam, dan mengubah insight menjadi keputusan strategis.Di peran ini, Anda akan berada di jantung pengambilan keputusan memahami apa yang benar-benar bekerja, apa yang tidak, dan ke mana kita harus melangkah berikutnya.

Tanggung Jawab (Job Description)1.	Turn Data Into Strategic InsightMelakukan analisis data dan riset pasar untuk memahami tren industri, kebutuhan pelanggan, posisi kompetitif perusahaan serta peluang dan area yang perlu ditingkatkan dalam operasional bisnis.Melakukan riset dan analisis mendalam (in-depth analysis) terhadap customer, marketing metrics, competitor landscape, serta tren marketing terbaru untuk mengidentifikasi peluang dan menutup gap pada produk maupun funnel.Menggali data operasional, data pelanggan, data pasar untuk menemukan pola, peluang, dan risiko yang tidak terlihat oleh orang lain. 2.	Drive Decision-MakingMenyajikan insight yang tajam dan relevan untuk membantu manajemen mengambil keputusan berbasis data, bukan asumsi.Bertanggung jawab atas fungsi analitik dengan merancang strategi pelacakan (tracking), membangun kerangka pengukuran (measurement framework), serta memberikan insight yang jelas terkait aktivitas operasional dan marketing.Berkolaborasi dengan tim lintas fungsi untuk memberikan insight yang mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis3.	Solve Real Business ProblemsMengidentifikasi bottleneck, inefficiency, dan peluang growth dalam proses bisnis, lalu memberikan solusi yang actionable.Mendukung pelaksanaan A/B testing dan desain eksperimen, memastikan setiap project dapat diukur dengan baik dan hasilnya valid secara statistik. 4.	Build Data-Driven SystemMengembangkan dashboard, model analitik, dan framework pengukuran yang menjadi fondasi pengambilan keputusan perusahaan.5.	Collaborate Across FunctionsBekerja lintas tim (Operations, Marketing, Finance, Product) untuk memastikan setiap strategi didukung oleh data yang solid.Kualifikasi (Requirements)Pendidikan minimal Diploma/Sarjana di bidang terkait (relevan).Memiliki pengalaman bekerja minimal 1 s.d. 5 tahun dibidang data analyst dan business analyst (lebih diutamakan yang menguasai market research dan marketing analysis).Mampu berpikir kritis dan sistematis serta mampu menghubungkan data dengan konteks bisnis.Pengalaman dalam menggunakan alat analisis data (Google Analytics, Power BI, SQL, Python dan tools sejenisnya), termasuk kemampuan mengolah big data secara efisien.Berpengalaman membuat dashboard menggunakan tools visualisasi data (Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI atau sejenisnya).Memahami berbagai channel digital marketing (iklan berbayar, SEO, referral, pertumbuhan organik, kampanye CRM).Memahami statistik, analisis tren, dan machine learning dasar.Kemampuan untuk bekerja dengan data besar dan kompleks. Berpikir analitis, detail-oriented, serta mampu menyajikan data secara logis.Komunikatif & kolaboratif, bisa bekerja sama dengan tim marketing, sales, dan operasional.Lancar berbahasa Inggris.Kompensani dan BenefitGaji dan tunjangan yang kompetitif dengan insentif (bonus) kinerja.BPJS (Asuransi kesehatan).Exposure langsung ke decision-making level.Lingkungan kerja yang mendorong thinking, ownership, dan impact.Kesempatan berkembang menjadi future leader di bidang data, business & strategy.

description:
Job Description – Senior System Analyst
Client: Sigmatech (Financial / Multi-Finance Industry)
Status: ASAP Hiring, WFO Onsite South Jakarta

Responsibilities:
* Analyze, design, and document system integration requirements between core multi-finance systems, digital platforms, and third-party applications (e.g., payment gateways, banking systems, mobile apps).
* Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams, ensuring business requirements are translated into clear functional and technical specifications.
* Perform system impact analysis and provide solution design for integration of new modules, APIs, and external services.
* Collaborate with developers, QA, project managers, and vendors to deliver high-quality integration solutions within agreed timelines.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including system architecture diagrams, data mapping, and interface specifications.
* Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test scenarios, validating test results, and ensuring alignment with business expectations.
* Provide post-implementation support and troubleshooting for integration issues, ensuring business continuity.
* Identify and recommend process improvements to optimize system integration and data flow.
* Ensure compliance with financial industry standards, regulations, and security policies in all system integration projects.

Requirements
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience as a System Analyst, with at least 2+ years in financial or multi-finance industry.
* Proven experience in system integration projects (API, ESB, middleware, data mapping, third-party system integration).
* Strong understanding of finance and loan lifecycle processes (loan application, disbursement, repayment, collection, reporting).
* Hands-on experience with SQL, data analysis, and system modeling tools.
* Familiarity with integration tools/technologies (e.g., REST API, SOAP, JSON, XML, Kafka, or MuleSoft) is a strong plus.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to liaise with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, Agile environment with tight deadlines and multiple stakeholders.
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.

description: At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential.Join Glints as a Software Engineer Intern and be part of our mission to help people and organizations realize their human potential. You’ll work with experienced engineers on real-world products that power job matching, hiring, and talent development in Southeast Asia.Whether your focus is frontend, backend, or full-stack, you’ll build scalable solutions, learn agile development, and gain mentorship from Glints’ high-performance engineering team.A Pathway to Your Full-Time CareerPlease note: This program is designed as a direct launchpad for a full-time career at Glints. Our primary goal is to mentor and develop promising talent into long-term team members.Full-Time Conversion: While not guaranteed, this internship has a strong potential for a full-time (FT) offer. Conversion is based on your performance during the program and business needs at the time of completion.Eligibility: Because of this, the ideal candidate is a final-year university student or a recent graduate who is able to transition into a full-time role.Commitment & Location: This is a full-time role. While the on-site requirement for the internship is negotiable, we expect you to work from our office upon conversion to a full-time position.What You'll Be DoingIn this role, you will:- Collaborate with an agile development team to support the delivery of impactful web features and improvements.- Assist in building and testing web application features, primarily using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and React or similar frameworks.- Support frontend development tasks such as fixing bugs, improving UI, or implementing small features under close guidance.- Participate in code reviews, and team discussions where you will learn industry best practices and coding standards.- Be mentored by team members and gradually take on more responsibility as you grow in technical confidence and capability.Why You Should Join Us- Collaboration: You’ll be part of a supportive and diverse team, learning from experienced engineers while contributing to real projects in a collaborative environment.- Real-World Experience: You will be working on one of our biggest products by user base, which is currently one of the leading job marketplaces in Indonesia.- Multicultural Environment: Join a multicultural team with members from different countries. We value your unique background and fresh perspective.- Learning & Innovation: We encourage curiosity and creativity. You’ll be supported to explore new ideas and grow your technical and problem-solving skills.- Meaningful Contribution: Your work will help improve a platform that positively impacts the careers of millions of young professionals across Southeast Asia.Who We Are Looking For We’re looking for enthusiastic learners who are passionate about web development and eager to grow through hands-on experience. While we don’t expect interns to be experts, we value a strong foundation, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.- Web Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.- Frontend Development: Some experience in React and frameworks like Next.js, and a desire to learn how modern web applications are built.- APIs: Basic understanding of how web apps communicate with backend services using REST or GraphQL.- Version Control: Familiarity with Git for tracking code changes and collaborating with a team.- Responsive Design: Awareness of responsive design principles and the ability to create layouts that work across devices.- Performance Awareness: Interest in learning how to make websites fast and efficient.- Security Awareness: Open to learning best practices for keeping web applications secure.Soft Skills- Problem-Solving: A logical mindset and curiosity to debug and figure things out.- Communication: Ability to ask good questions, explain what you're working on, and share progress or blockers clearly.- Team Collaboration: Willingness to work closely with peers and mentors, and to contribute to a supportive team environment.- Adaptability: Comfortable learning new tools, frameworks, and adapting to feedback.- Attention to Detail: Care in writing clean, working code and testing what you build.- Continuous Learning: Enthusiasm for improving your skills and keeping up with web development trends.- Agile Mindset: Willingness to work in an iterative process, take part in standups, and deliver work in small, valuable chunks.Let's Realize Human Potential.At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential.We have impacted many lives but there’s still plenty to be done. If you’re ready to grow and make an impact, you’ve come to the right place.What is Glints?Glints is the leading talent ecosystem in Southeast Asia, with an enduring purpose of contributing to a world where people and organizations can realize their human potential. Today, Glints is the most well-funded and well-capitalized startup in the talent recruitment space in Southeast Asia, with over US$80M in total investments raised till date.Our tech-enabled approach to recruitment and career discovery connects more than 3 million candidates to their next dream opportunities. We have also supported more than 50,000 companies in finding top talent and doubling recruitment efficiency.Our agility and firm hold on our core purpose and values have allowed us to remain resilient and thrive through tumultuous times. In 2020, we were recognized by LinkedIn as one of the Top 10 Startups in Singapore. In 2022, we were featured in the top 20 of Nikkei-FT-Statista High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2021 list. Moreover, we were also featured in the top 10 fastest-growing companies in Singapore by The Straits Times.Who We AreAt Glints, personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth. That's why we created the Glints Culture Code: #RIIBCOH. It defines our values, is what guides our decisions and actions, and is what makes us special.#RIIBCOH:1. Relentlessly Resourceful: Whatever it takes, just make it happen (ethically)2. Integrity: Have courage, be guided by the truth, don’t be afraid 3. Impact: Missionaries, not mercenaries4. Beginners’ Mindset: Stay humble, don’t be attached to ego5. Customer Obsessed: Customers First6. Ownership: Care intensely about the mission and take responsibility7. High Standards: Dream big and deliver epic outcomes fastWhere we workSince Glints was officially launched in Singapore in 2015, we've rapidly grown our footprint across Greater Southeast Asia to operate in Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Philippines.

Deskripsi Perusahaan PT  Waschen Alora Indonesia (Alora Group) adalah sebuah entitas induk perusahan yang memiliki core business di bidang jasa kebersihan, seperti: Laundry rumah sakit (Healtcare Laundry), Penyewaan linen rumah sakit (Linen Rental), Laundry untuk Perusahaan (Corporate Laundry), Laundry Retail (residence), Jasa kebersihan rumah (Home Care) dan Jasa Kebersihan Kantor (Office Care). Kami tidak mencari sekadar analis data. Kami mencari “arsitek pertumbuhan”, seseorang yang mampu mengubah data menjadi strategi, dan strategi menjadi dampak nyata.  Kami mencari “problem solver berbasis data”, seseorang yang mampu melihat pola di balik angka, memahami bisnis secara mendalam, dan mengubah insight menjadi keputusan strategis.Di peran ini, Anda akan berada di jantung pengambilan keputusan memahami apa yang benar-benar bekerja, apa yang tidak, dan ke mana kita harus melangkah berikutnya.

Turn Data Into Strategic InsightMelakukan analisis data dan riset pasar untuk memahami tren industri, kebutuhan pelanggan, posisi kompetitif perusahaan serta peluang dan area yang perlu ditingkatkan dalam operasional bisnis.Melakukan riset dan analisis mendalam (in-depth analysis) terhadap customer, marketing metrics, competitor landscape, serta tren marketing terbaru untuk mengidentifikasi peluang dan menutup gap pada produk maupun funnel.Menggali data operasional, data pelanggan, data pasar untuk menemukan pola, peluang, dan risiko yang tidak terlihat oleh orang lain. 2.	Drive Decision-MakingMenyajikan insight yang tajam dan relevan untuk membantu manajemen mengambil keputusan berbasis data, bukan asumsi.Bertanggung jawab atas fungsi analitik dengan merancang strategi pelacakan (tracking), membangun kerangka pengukuran (measurement framework), serta memberikan insight yang jelas terkait aktivitas operasional dan marketing.Berkolaborasi dengan tim lintas fungsi untuk memberikan insight yang mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis3.	Solve Real Business ProblemsMengidentifikasi bottleneck, inefficiency, dan peluang growth dalam proses bisnis, lalu memberikan solusi yang actionable.Mendukung pelaksanaan A/B testing dan desain eksperimen, memastikan setiap project dapat diukur dengan baik dan hasilnya valid secara statistik. 4.	Build Data-Driven SystemMengembangkan dashboard, model analitik, dan framework pengukuran yang menjadi fondasi pengambilan keputusan perusahaan.5.	Collaborate Across FunctionsBekerja lintas tim (Operations, Marketing, Finance, Product) untuk memastikan setiap strategi didukung oleh data yang solid.Kualifikasi (Requirements)Pendidikan minimal Diploma/Sarjana di bidang terkait (relevan).Memiliki pengalaman bekerja minimal 1 s.d. 5 tahun dibidang data analyst dan business analyst (lebih diutamakan yang menguasai market research dan marketing analysis).Mampu berpikir kritis dan sistematis serta mampu menghubungkan data dengan konteks bisnis.Pengalaman dalam menggunakan alat analisis data (Google Analytics, Power BI, SQL, Python dan tools sejenisnya), termasuk kemampuan mengolah big data secara efisien.Berpengalaman membuat dashboard menggunakan tools visualisasi data (Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI atau sejenisnya).Memahami berbagai channel digital marketing (iklan berbayar, SEO, referral, pertumbuhan organik, kampanye CRM).Memahami statistik, analisis tren, dan machine learning dasar.Kemampuan untuk bekerja dengan data besar dan kompleks. Berpikir analitis, detail-oriented, serta mampu menyajikan data secara logis.Komunikatif & kolaboratif, bisa bekerja sama dengan tim marketing, sales, dan operasional.Lancar berbahasa Inggris.Kompensani dan BenefitGaji dan tunjangan yang kompetitif dengan insentif (bonus) kinerja.BPJS (Asuransi kesehatan).Exposure langsung ke decision-making level.Lingkungan kerja yang mendorong thinking, ownership, dan impact.Kesempatan berkembang menjadi future leader di bidang data, business & strategy.

At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential. description:
At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential.
We're looking for an IT Intern to join our IT team in Batam, to support the day-to-day technology operations that keep our teams productive and secure across the region.What You'll Be Doing- Provide first-line IT support to employees: troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues- Manage employee onboarding and offboarding from the IT side: device setup, account provisioning, access management- Maintain and track IT asset inventory (laptops, monitors, peripherals) across offices- Operate and monitor existing automation workflows for common IT requests- Document IT processes and build runbooks to strengthen the team's knowledge base- Support vendor coordination for device procurement, repairs, and logistics
Why You Should Join Us- Learn by doing: You'll be hands-on from day one, working across real IT operations, not fetching coffee- Growth path: This internship is designed to grow into a full-time role for the right person. We invest in people who invest in themselves- Mentorship: Work directly with experienced IT professionals who will teach you the craft- Impact: Your work directly affects every employee's productivity, when IT works well, everyone works well
Who We Are Looking For- Fresh graduate or final-year student in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field- Genuine curiosity about technology: you tinker, you Google, you figure things out- Strong sense of responsibility - you don't drop the ball- Good communication skills - you can explain technical things to non-technical people- Willingness to learn fast and push yourself beyond your comfort zone- Any exposure to scripting, automation, or IT tools is a plus - but attitude matters more than experience

- Willing to work from the Batam office (Working From Office, Monday–Friday)

Let’s Realize Human Potential.At Glints, we are building the #1 tech-enabled recruitment and career discovery platform in Southeast Asia that helps people and organizations realize their human potential.We have impacted many lives but there’s still plenty to be done. If you’re ready to grow and make an impact, you’ve come to the right place.What is Glints?Glints is the leading talent ecosystem in Southeast Asia, with an enduring purpose of contributing to a world where people and organizations can realize their human potential. Today, Glints is the most well-funded and well-capitalized startup in the talent recruitment space in Southeast Asia, with over US$80M in total investments raised till date.Our tech-enabled approach to recruitment and career discovery connects more than 3 million candidates to their next dream opportunities. We have also supported more than 50,000 companies in finding top talent and doubling recruitment efficiency.Our agility and firm hold on our core purpose and values have allowed us to remain resilient and thrive through tumultuous times. In 2020, we were recognized by LinkedIn as one of the Top 10 Startups in Singapore. In 2022, we were featured in the top 20 of Nikkei-FT-Statista High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2021 list. Moreover, we were also featured in the top 10 fastest-growing companies in Singapore by The Straits Times.Who We AreAt Glints, personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth. That's why we created the Glints Culture Code: #RIIBCOH. It defines our values, is what guides our decisions and actions, and is what makes us special.#RIIBCOH:1. Relentlessly Resourceful: Whatever it takes, just make it happen (ethically)2. Integrity: Have courage, be guided by the truth, don’t be afraid 3. Impact: Missionaries, not mercenaries4. Beginners’ Mindset: Stay humble, don’t be attached to ego5. Customer Obsessed: Customers First6. Ownership: Care intensely about the mission and take responsibility7. High Standards: Dream big and deliver epic outcomes fastWhere we workSince Glints was officially launched in Singapore in 2015, we've rapidly grown our footprint across Greater Southeast Asia to operate in Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Taiwan, Malaysia and Philippines.Learn more about Glints and our culture at bit.ly/glintsculture.
